title: Close registry before exec in carrel run
description:
runCmd opens the registry with defer reg.Close(), then calls syscall.Exec to replace the process with OMP. The defer never runs, so the Dolt noms LOCK file descriptor is inherited by the OMP process and held for the entire session. All carrel commands that write to the registry (config edit, config scan) fail with 'cannot update manifest: database is read only' while OMP is running.

## Context
File: cmd/carrel/main.go, runCmd function (~line 179). The defer at line 159 (defer reg.Close()) is dead code when Exec succeeds.
acceptance_criteria: Add explicit reg.Close() before syscall.Exec in runCmd. Verify: start an OMP session via carrel run, then from another shell run 'carrel config scan carrel-omp' — it must succeed.

title: Enable external repository registration
description:
Tracking epic. Carrel must support registering external (non-owned) repos as consumers with target-specific sources, enabling secondary-configs to migrate from carula's setup.sh to carrel's registry pipeline.

## Context
Brief: /workspace/secondary-configs/docs/workflow/briefs/2026-05-06_carrel-migration_brief.md
acceptance_criteria: configure-carrel.sh (Appendix A of the carrel-migration brief) runs end-to-end without error. 'carrel plan' from /workspace/core-stack shows the expected entries. 'carrel verify' passes after deployment. setup.sh is retired.

title: Onboarding CLI
description: CLI commands for registering consumers and sources. Depends on Registry Idempotency epic.
acceptance_criteria: 'carrel register consumer' and 'carrel register source' commands exist, are idempotent, and support the full onboarding workflow (register, link, scan, slot generation) in one pass.

title: Registry Idempotency
description: Prerequisite for the onboarding CLI. All Dolt registry INSERT operations must become upserts so that onboarding commands are safe to re-run.
acceptance_criteria: All registry write operations (RegisterConsumer, RegisterSource, LinkConsumerSource) are idempotent. Tests pass on both Dolt and Mem backends.

title: Implement carrel register source subcommand
description:
Add 'carrel register source <alias>' CLI command. Flags: --path (required), --scope (required: universal|target), --consumer (optional, links source to consumer when set). When --consumer is provided: calls RegisterSource, LinkConsumerSource, ScanSource, and generateDefaultSlots in one pass. Idempotent.

## Context
Files: cmd/carrel/main.go or cmd/carrel/register.go. Reuses RegisterSource, LinkConsumerSource, scanner.ScanSource, generateDefaultSlots.
acceptance_criteria: 'carrel register source secondary-configs --path=... --scope=target --consumer=core-stack' succeeds. Source appears in 'carrel sources'. Entries are scanned. Default slots are generated for the consumer. Re-running succeeds.

title: Implement carrel register consumer subcommand
description:
Add 'carrel register consumer <alias>' CLI command. Flags: --path (required), --deploy-root (defaults to <path>/.omp), --kind (defaults to repo). Calls RegisterConsumer. Idempotent via upsert.

## Context
Files: cmd/carrel/main.go or new cmd/carrel/register.go. Reuses registry.RegisterConsumer.
acceptance_criteria: 'carrel register consumer core-stack --path=/workspace/core-stack' succeeds. Re-running with same args succeeds. Consumer appears in 'carrel status'. Running without --path errors with usage.

title: Test registry upsert operations
description:
Add tests for RegisterConsumer, RegisterSource, and LinkConsumerSource upsert semantics in both Dolt and Mem backends.

## Context
Files: internal/registry/registry_test.go. Follow the pattern of the existing RegisterEntryUpsert test.
acceptance_criteria: Tests in registry_test.go: (1) RegisterConsumer twice with same ID, changed path — no error, path updated. (2) RegisterSource twice with same ID, changed scope — no error, scope updated. (3) LinkConsumerSource twice with same pair — no error.

title: Make RegisterConsumer, RegisterSource, LinkConsumerSource upserts
description:
All three Dolt registry INSERT operations must become upserts so onboarding commands are safe to re-run. Same pattern as the RegisterEntry fix: INSERT ... ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE for RegisterConsumer and RegisterSource. INSERT IGNORE for LinkConsumerSource (link table, nothing to update).

## Context
Files: internal/registry/dolt_registry.go. Reference: the RegisterEntry upsert fix already merged on main.
acceptance_criteria: RegisterConsumer: re-registering same ID with changed path/deploy_root updates the row without error. RegisterSource: re-registering same ID with changed path/scope updates the row. LinkConsumerSource: re-linking an existing pair succeeds silently. All three verified by tests.

title: Move AGENTS.md beads instructions to universal APPEND_SYSTEM.md
description:
AGENTS.md contains a beads integration section (between BEGIN/END BEADS INTEGRATION markers) with quick reference, rules, and session completion protocol. This content belongs in the universal APPEND_SYSTEM.md so all consumers inherit it. Move it using carrel config commands, not direct file edits.

## Context
AGENTS.md: lines between <!-- BEGIN BEADS INTEGRATION --> and <!-- END BEADS INTEGRATION -->. Target: omp/APPEND_SYSTEM.md already has a Task Tracking (Beads) section — merge, do not duplicate. Requires cr-ce6 (registry lock fix) to run carrel config edit during an OMP session.
acceptance_criteria: Beads integration content from AGENTS.md is present in omp/APPEND_SYSTEM.md. AGENTS.md no longer contains the beads integration section. Both changes made via 'carrel config edit'. Registry hashes are in sync.
close_reason: Beads instructions merged into omp/APPEND_SYSTEM.md. AGENTS.md beads section left in place — bd-managed, would be re-injected if removed. APPEND_SYSTEM.md is now authoritative.

title: Update carrel run guard for unregistered repos
description:
The 'carrel run' error message for unregistered repos currently says 'run carrel discover'. Update it to explain how to register the repo via 'carrel register consumer' and 'carrel register source'.

## Context
File: cmd/carrel/main.go:163. Current message: "unregistered repo %s; run 'carrel discover' to see available repos".
acceptance_criteria: Running 'carrel run' from an unregistered repo fails with a message that names 'carrel register consumer' and 'carrel register source' as the resolution steps.
